newsitem.title: USA: WesterFed says to incur extra cost in 1998.
newsitem.headline: WesterFed says to incur extra cost in 1998.

text.p: WesterFed Financial Corp said Friday it will incur "significant costs" related to a system-wide conversion, and it will continue to incur "significant" expenses during a portion of the next quarter related to training.
The company said it estimates the investment in the conversion project is about about $3.0 million.

In addition, the company said that adding two new branches, developing commercial lending centers in the bank's markets and marketing its consolidated services will further increase operating costs during fiscal year 1998.
The company is converting its commercial banking data center software and bank hardware, and is scheduled to complete the project in February 1998.
The company said the conversion will all the bank to realize greater operating efficiencies by eliminating duplicative overhead.
This overhead is related to the current dual computer systems resulting from a recent acquisition.
In addition, the company said it has incurred significant personnel expenditures during the quarter just ended from the training program.
It said all bank employees are being trained in sales skills.
The company reported earnings per share for the fourth quarter of $0.38 compared to $0.29 for the same period a year ago.
